seat: Codex critical design: replace C with a relation-compression cost hypothesis
scope: Design, directed source reading, primary-source search and hand arithmetic only. No model execution, RTL, build, board, or shared-document modification.

decision.old_C: The old dynamic fragment/merge plus bounded replacement-lease action set is exactly available to the stated same-information ordinary dynamic legalizer. A different score might still be a useful algorithm, but no trace can prove that its actions are unreachable by an oracle permitted to select those identical actions. Stop demanding that impossible separation; an algorithm claim would instead need a concrete executable policy and computational/information/cost comparison.
decision.replacement: COPY-informed relation-compressed IOTLB: preserve separately validated source/destination translations while sharing a learned VPN delta and PPN delta across sparse COPY pairs.
decision.positive_hypothesis: 如果真实双缓冲/对象搬运工作负载中，一批稀疏 COPY 的源目的映射存在可低成本维持的配对关系，而关系引导的编码、发现、查找和单边失效在完整成本下，比已发表空间压缩及同信息普通非相邻字典压缩有更好的容量/延迟/面积点，那么可以形成以 COPY 语义驱动翻译表示的机制贡献。
decision.not_a_claim: The current positive is an exact representation-size construction, not net RTL area, fewer real misses, faster copy, or established novelty. A generic relation dictionary can encode the same mappings; its exact parity is acknowledged rather than hidden.
decision.role: A small, falsifiable alternative cost direction, subordinate to root route selection. The next work should settle mapping prevalence and complete structure cost before any RTL.

problem.scene: A service repeatedly copies objects between two sparse virtual buffer arenas. Source/destination virtual offsets correspond, but allocated source pages across objects are physically fragmented. Linux can optionally obtain an order-1 physical allocation per object, placing the source and destination in its two pages; this gives a constant physical pair delta without requiring all objects to occupy one contiguous allocation.
problem.example_geometry: For object i, S_VPN[i] is arbitrary, D_VPN[i]=S_VPN[i]+dv, S_PPN[i] is arbitrary even-valued, D_PPN[i]=S_PPN[i]+1. Different objects need not have adjacent VPNs or PPNs. Sparse virtual arenas and order-1 page-pair allocation are a feasible software construction, not evidence this distribution already occurs in the measured board workload.
problem.software_cost: Count order-1 allocation success/fragmentation, allocation and mapping CPU time, two separately permissioned mappings, pinned bytes, virtual arena reservation, NUMA/bank-placement consequences, producer/consumer cache maintenance, and descriptor construction. It uses 2 pages per page pair, not extra bounce pages; allocator constraints can nevertheless impose an opportunity cost. Compare an ordinary allocator, fixed paired allocator with ordinary IOTLB, contiguous/huge-page mappings when legal, and all controls on exactly the same mapping.
problem.new_representation: An explicit row covers two arbitrarily separated virtual pages and two possibly far-separated physical pages whose deltas are shared across a group. It does not cover intervening pages and does not infer any unobserved PTE or access permission.
problem.identity: Initial scope is one-stage 4 KiB mappings with per-group exact PSCID/GSCID/stage identity. Distinct SIDs retain their native device-context checks; different contexts have separate groups. Same PPN never supplies another SID's permission. Two-stage composition, global mappings, mixed page sizes and MMIO use ordinary fallback until separately designed.

rule_and_pseudocode.group: G=(identity,dv,dp,valid), where dv and dp are exact unsigned modulo-width differences; full address/domain checks and no-overflow range restrictions are performed before admission. A more implementation-friendly version rejects wraparound groups.
rule_and_pseudocode.row: R=(group,svpn,sppn,source_attributes,destination_attributes,source_valid,destination_valid). Group selection may be structurally banked rather than paid in every row; flexible placement must pay row group pointers.
decode: For an ordinary IOMMU lookup q with a successfully resolved native context, find matching groups with the exact translation identity.
Within each matching group, compare qVPN to row.svpn for source role, and qVPN-dv to row.svpn for destination role.

If that role's valid bit is clear, it is a miss. Otherwise obtain sppn for source or sppn+dp for destination and test that role's own complete cached permission attributes under the normal IOMMU access check.
Multiple matching representations must decode to the same actual mapping/attributes, or the insertion is rejected/duplicates are invalidated; do not silently prioritize an inconsistent alias.
fill: A COPY relation hint contains only source/destination virtual geometry and ownership. It never constitutes permission or physical-address evidence.
Every source and destination page must first complete its own normal translation and permission processing. No reduction of the first cold permissions is assumed.

On a successful destination fill, the optional COPY hint proposes the corresponding source VPN. Probe an existing, still-valid source mapping with matching identity. If unavailable, install the ordinary destination mapping and continue; do not hold up data waiting for compression.

Compare actual resolved PPN difference with an existing group's dp, or form a new group only if its complete amortized cost is beneficial. The source and destination may have different R/W/U/etc attributes; retain them independently.

Install the complete compressed row atomically before deleting ordinary copies. Account for temporary coexistence, fill/probe ports, full proof registers and invalidation priority. If resources or timing do not permit compression now, keep ordinary entries.
Group reconfiguration is legal only when every valid row using that group has been drained or moved to a complete ordinary representation. Never change a live group delta in place.
invalidation_and_fallback: A targeted source-page invalidation clears source_valid only; a targeted destination-page invalidation clears destination_valid only. A context/global operation clears every matching half. Group and row matching must follow the native global/stage semantics; initial restricted mode rejects unsupported cases.

The surviving half remains valid and can be used alone, but its retained base/attributes have a real cost. A remapped half is admitted back only after its own new successful walk proves the relation, otherwise an ordinary singleton is installed.

Already translated/published transactions retain the native request owner and legal AXI completion. This compression changes the cache representation, not the architectural cut point of invalidation. No cancellation of first VALID, accepted AR/AW or W/B is proposed.

On permission failure no valid half is created. Compression misses, unavailable pairing metadata, unsupported page mode, group overflow, or backpressure use the unmodified normal translation path. Compression is never required to make forward progress.
rule_and_pseudocode.fairness: Retain existing V/A arbitration and explicit capacity accounting. A compressed pair counts by bytes and represented permissions, not as one magically free quota entry. Compare quotas in both physical bytes and equivalent pages; an allocation improvement for V which deprives A is reported. Compression work has bounded background service and cannot starve demand lookup, invalidation, or fill.

hand_positive.status: Exact field-count positive against an ordinary uncompressed map, not a full implementation result and not an exclusive positive against the generic relation dictionary.
hand_positive.configuration: Use the native 29-bit VPN interface (two high bits are zero in restricted Sv39), native 44-bit PPN, and 8 per-stage attribute bits from rv_iommu_pkg.sv: is_1G/is_2M/g/u/x/w/r/v, not A/D bits. Keep both peers one-stage/4 KiB for this arithmetic; do not compare against the unoptimized two-stage native record and claim all those unused bits as a mechanism saving. A fully fixed-4-KiB specialization can remove is_1G/is_2M from both peers: the named data subsets become 844 vs 1280 bits, with the same 436-bit difference. Both can also specialize the zero high VPN bits; all reductions must be applied symmetrically.
hand_positive.uncompressed_mapping_bits: V+P+A+1 = 82 bits per represented mapping, before context and replacement metadata. Sixteen mappings need 1312 bits.
hand_positive.pair_row_bits: V+P+2*A+2 = 91 bits per row; eight rows need 728 bits.
hand_positive.group_bits: Each dv+dp+valid directory record is V+P+1 = 74 bits. Two groups need 148 bits. Structurally four rows per group avoid a row group pointer in this exact construction; generic control receives the same structural option.
hand_positive.context_accounting: If exact identity uses PSCID20+GSCID16+stage2=38 bits per group, both equally banked peers add 76 bits. Then these named fields total 952 vs 1388 bits, saving the same 436 bits (31.4121%). SID/DDTC authorization, row/group controls, global semantics, ports, pipelines and proof temporaries remain outside this subset.
hand_positive.general_formula: For equal grouping and independent attributes, B_plain=2*N*(V+P+A+1), B_pair=N*(V+P+2*A+2)+G*(V+P+1). Saving=N*(V+P)-G*(V+P+1). Here it is 73*N-74*G.
hand_positive.performance_implication_is_conditional: Only if the complete equal-cost design admits all W active mappings while a control can retain at most C<W, a phase barrier separating repeated full working-set rounds gives the control at least W-C absent mappings at the beginning of each later round. The first cold round still requires W validations in every design. Demand reordering, prefetch, ordinary compression and replacement optimization are allowed; they may hide the walks or increase C. Consequently W-C is not automatically exposed copy latency, and a naive all-miss cyclic LRU trace is not the strongest control.
hand_positive.all_copy_work: For eight 64-byte COPYs per round, every peer has eight real descriptors, sixteen endpoint permission checks, eight data AR, 64 64-bit R beats, eight AW, 64 W beats and eight B responses. Reusing a representation never removes these actual data obligations. Additional rounds have the same real byte work. Source/destination visibility and producer/consumer phase costs are identical.
hand_positive.strong_dictionary_result: An ordinary dictionary permitted the same arbitrary nonadjacent two-mapping relation can use exactly the same 91-bit rows and 74-bit groups. It exactly reproduces all field-count savings. This is an explicit constructive equivalence, not an inference that some unspecified future baseline could be enhanced. No independent compression-algorithm claim follows from 1312→876.

neighbor_counterexamples.change: Keep the sparse source/destination VPN pairs, but independently remap every destination so each pair has a distinct PPN delta.
neighbor_counterexamples.result: G=N gives B_pair-B_plain=N bits even before any new ports/state. For eight singleton groups the compressed representation is 1320 vs 1312 bits. Ordinary singleton fallback is correct; the hypothesized cost gain disappears.

neighbor_counterexamples.change: Only source pages are reused after initial COPY; destination pages are one-shot.
neighbor_counterexamples.result: Retained destination attributes/validity and shared pair lifetime can waste capacity. A strong ordinary cache evicts destinations independently. The candidate must support independent half retirement and count stranded base state; keeping both halves pinned is an invalid favorable setup.

neighbor_counterexamples.change: All relevant mappings are adjacent and affine within each arena.
neighbor_counterexamples.result: CoLT/range/clustered entries or huge pages can represent many more than two mappings per entry. Pair compression may be dominated; ordinary spatial compression is the required fallback/control.

neighbor_counterexamples.change: Each page pair is used once, or ordinary IOTLB already holds the working set.
neighbor_counterexamples.result: The cold validation work is unchanged, and extra decode/fill cycles can only hurt completion time unless a genuine lower-area same-throughput point is measured.

neighbor_counterexamples.change: Order-1 pair allocation has material failure/migration cost or conflicts with memory-bank locality.
neighbor_counterexamples.result: End-to-end software/data-memory cost may exceed any translation saving. Allocator layout is a charged mechanism component; it cannot be assumed free or natural.

complete_strong_controls: Ordinary fully associative/partitioned IOTLB at equal complete bits, ports and critical-path target; optimize the same one-stage 4 KiB restriction and common-context factoring. Give it independent single-page replacement and all actual native in-flight resources.

CoLT, clustered/multi-granular TLB, current variable/multiple encoding compression and range/huge-page mappings when their mapping preconditions hold. Do not force the map to be fragmented for only the controls.

Generic nonadjacent dictionary/base-delta map: it may identify arbitrary VPN/PPN relationships, keep separate permissions/valid bits, independently retire halves, use the exact descriptor hints, and use structurally banked contexts. Its rows can exactly match the proposed encoding; document whether any distinction in discovery/ports/update cost actually remains.

A software-built relation table using the same pinned mapping and descriptor knowledge, with actual mapping/version synchronization and CPU/setup costs. Give it amortization over the same repeated workload, not a forced per-COPY syscall.

ATS/full physical translation vouchers and IOTLB index+generation/validated-index handles using the same owned metadata budget and correct invalidations. These may lower lookup cost even without relation compression. Plain pretranslation and carrying physical addresses are published capabilities.

All-necessary-permission preparation, write one-page lookahead, dynamic ordinary legalizer+same feedback bounded pinning, descriptor source/destination grouping, larger ordinary IOTLB, and actual useful parallelism at the same resource cost. No extra walker or four-prepare-slot assumption is built into this proposal.

complete_cost_ledger.mandatory_storage: Count exact context/mode/global metadata, group and row validity, group references or fixed-bank fragmentation, independent half ages/recency, group replacement, normal singleton/escape bank and all unused reserved bits. Count hardware max width, not just average compression ratio.
complete_cost_ledger.pair_discovery: A successful destination fill can use a COPY-provided virtual delta to select a source candidate, rather than searching every pair of mappings. But descriptor-aware ordinary dictionary control gets the same hint. The current native ordinary IOMMU input has no complete immutable COPY pair label: connecting frontend geometry to source/destination fills needs paid metadata and ownership. A full proof temporary can erase the 436-bit eight-pair subset saving; this is a decisive cost gate.
complete_cost_ledger.ports: At least an extra fill-time candidate lookup or a serialized demand-port use; normal source/destination queries require separate role comparisons or a group subtractor plus comparison. If G groups are checked in parallel, pay G subtractors/match paths or record serialized latency. Physical reconstruction requires dp addition. Simultaneous demand/fill/invalidation still needs arbitration or extra ports.
complete_cost_ledger.critical_path: The existing fully associative lookup directly returns content. The new group match, VPN subtraction, role selection and PPN reconstruction can add a pipeline stage. A one-cycle throughput claim requires registered design and actual timing, not a bit-count derivation. The same area could fund a ordinary extra lookup port or more entries; compare that frontier.
complete_cost_ledger.transient_cost: Installing a compressed row before removing ordinary entries requires a temporary complete proof or reserved destination storage, valid/epoch synchronization and duplicate-detection rules. Compression racing targeted invalidation must not resurrect a half. Count any backpressure/demand delay even if background work is nominally optional.
complete_cost_ledger.metadata_transport: If a COPY ID, parent geometry or delta hint is carried in AXI user/head records, count its bits through every retained native head and spill stage. Four DMA channels do not imply four freely available preparation slots. Current normal frontend completion is tied to actual write responses; reuse existing ownership only after source-level lifetime proof.
complete_cost_ledger.permission_contract: The hint conveys correlation only. Each half has its own permission proof. Unknown/unsupported identity, mixed page size, revocation race, lookup ambiguity or failed translation goes through normal handling. Native NO_ERROR_HANDLING is not a new fault-recovery implementation.
complete_cost_ledger.system_cost: Charge Linux allocation/mapping, fragmentation and pinned-memory cost, page-table writes/invalidations, queue/MMIO submission and real COPY completion. Preserve the native eight request heads, 32 TC payload words and additional iDMA/pipeline storage as common resources. No reduction of those resources is derived here.

source_review.fact: Native GPPNW39 is 29, ppn_t is 44 bits; each iotlb stage content contains PPN plus eight bits is_1G/is_2M/g/u/x/w/r/v; two stage records form native content. The subset arithmetic deliberately compares equal one-stage records.

Native lookup matches PSCID/GSCID/stage/VPN and returns a complete content record; targeted/context invalidations and atomic per-entry update exist. A pair format requires changing these actual paths, not only a Python storage encoding.
COPY request carries source, destination, length and complete options including device_id and process_id. It is a real candidate hint source, but its lifetime and transport to IOMMU are not free.
Existing dynamic common/independent page-boundary splitting and owned source/destination/options make plain dynamic splitting a covered baseline action.
NO_ERROR_HANDLING reports neutral errors and completion follows write datapath last response; no new recovery or early complete is claimed.

downstream_decisive_plan.task: Extract exact candidate/control storage and critical data paths for 8 and 16 pair rows, with G=1/2/8 and no dropped options, proof temporary, context or spill metadata. Build only a cost worksheet and field-layout proposal first.
downstream_decisive_plan.advance_if: A concrete complete resource/latency point remains useful against ordinary independent mappings and same-information generic arbitrary relation dictionary; or exact mechanism/prior distinction is identified rather than merely assumed.
downstream_decisive_plan.stop_if: The generic relation dictionary with descriptor hints is identical in actions, representation, discovery and timing, and the claimed contribution was a distinct compression algorithm. If treating this common module itself as the proposed interface contribution, settle exact prior coverage before performance claims.

downstream_decisive_plan.task: Obtain a real feasible mapping/descriptor trace for repeated sparse copies from the current Linux workload or a declared order-1 paired allocator; charge its setup and fragmentation. Compare 64-byte and page-sized copies, phase barriers, V/A joint completion, and ordinary allocation/coalescing.
downstream_decisive_plan.advance_if: Pair groups persist long enough that setup and decode are amortized and translation capacity/lookup service is actually relevant.
downstream_decisive_plan.stop_if: Mapping regularity exists only by costly allocation, only one pass occurs, existing simple coalescing dominates, or the data/descriptor path hides every saved translation service.

downstream_decisive_plan.task: Hand trace one source-only and one destination-only invalidation during ordinary lookup/fill, with one half remapped outside its group, first VALID held and ordinary results already in flight. Include all fallback/proof state and preserve native completion.
downstream_decisive_plan.advance_if: No unvalidated half is returned, live deltas never change, and normal demand/invalidation makes progress without waiting on compression.
downstream_decisive_plan.stop_if: Correctness needs unbudgeted full shadow translations or an unsupported native cancellation/fault-replay capability.

downstream_decisive_plan.task: Only after D1-D3, use a small model with complete cold fills, real endpoint checks and actual R/W/B. Include optimum legal per-round ordering/replacement as a bound and actual executable generic compressed control. No RTL/build is requested in this design round.
downstream_decisive_plan.advance_if: A useful V/A/full-cost frontier difference remains, or equal performance at materially lower full implementation cost is established.
downstream_decisive_plan.stop_if: Only the named data-field subset shrinks, or a simple equal-cost control matches complete behavior and cost.

independent_judgments.rule_novelty: 因为共享 bit、稀疏字典表示、预翻译已有明确前作或具体对照覆盖，不能把这些通用动作改名为独立贡献。COPY 语义驱动的非局部配对、低成本发现与单边失效作为完整机制，需要准确最近前作核查；本轮没有以搜索未命中证明首创。
independent_judgments.exclusive_system_benefit: The generic relation dictionary exactly reproduces the present representation positive. No exclusive end-to-end gain is established. The open positive question is complete mechanism cost and discovered workload capability, not whether another implementation is forbidden from using the same encoding.
independent_judgments.engineering_feasibility: Restricted one-stage pair encoding is implementable in principle with existing normal permission completion, but requires nontrivial native lookup/fill/invalidation changes and COPY-hint transport. The saved subset may be smaller than the added state and ports.
independent_judgments.recommended_next_use: Give the downstream model D1-D3 as a bounded design/cost study if root wants a cost-oriented backup. Do not run more old C dynamic-fragment scheduling cases or describe this artifact as a successful hardware experiment.
